blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Consumers face brownout risks across the Visayas as the grid remains under red alert for a third straight day amid tight power supply. The country’s grid operator placed the Visayas under red alert from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m., still due to a power crunch caused by outages at several power plants in the Visayas and Mindanao.
